description: Waits for an AI verification session and returns a summary. Polls every 2 seconds until the lookup is ready or failed, or the session ends, or the timeout passes. Once the developer can see the verification URL in your message, call it with `untilTerminal: true` so it waits until the session ends. The result has the lookup state (including `aiSdkSessionId`, the ID the claimant sees in the Portal), the session status, `outcome` and `outcomeNote` for a failed session, `problem` with the failure detail, recent event types, and `next`: `share_url`, `waiting_for_user`, `waiting_for_lookup`, `done`, or `none`. When `fallback.recommended` is true, follow its `reason`. Authenticates with the org API key: `orgToken`, else `RECLAIM_ORG_SECRET`, else the key saved by `issue_org_token`.

orgToken.description: The organization API key (`rorg_…`). Defaults to the MCP server's RECLAIM_ORG_SECRET, then the key saved by `issue_org_token`. Never echo it back to the user.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait. Default 120, maximum 600.

untilTerminal.description: Recommended after you share the verification URL. If true, return only when the session ends or the lookup fails, not when the lookup is ready.

name: wait_for_ai_session
